paragraphs.source_en: That night, the granary in the Ashida compound was unbearably hot and stuffy. The rainy-season sky was blanketed with clouds, yet no rain fell. The cramped space was packed with people, making the oppression almost unimaginable.

paragraphs.source_zh: 夜，芦田苑里的谷仓格外闷热。梅雨季节的天空布满云朵，却不下雨。这极狭窄的地方又挤满了人，憋闷可想而知。

paragraphs.source_en: After daybreak they could no longer all remain crowded together, so they set up gilded screens and divided the granary into three sections. Lady Yodo and the other women occupied one section; in the middle were Ōno Harunaga, Mōri Katsunaga, Hayami Morihisa, and the other warriors who had survived the battlefield; in the innermost section were Toyotomi Hideyori and several pages.

units.source_en: After daybreak they could no longer all remain crowded together, so they set up gilded screens and divided the granary into three sections.

units.source_zh: 天亮以后，众人便不能都挤在一处，于是竖起金屏风，将谷仓分成三个部分。

units.source_en: Lady Yodo and the other women occupied one section; in the middle were Ōno Harunaga, Mōri Katsunaga, Hayami Morihisa, and the other warriors who had survived the battlefield; in the innermost section were Toyotomi Hideyori and several pages.
units.source_zh: 淀夫人及其他女人一处，中间为从战场上生还的大野治长、毛利胜永、速水守久以及其他武士，最里乃是丰臣秀赖和几个侍童。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天亮以后，众人便不能都挤在一处，于是竖起金屏风，将谷仓分成三个部分。淀夫人及其他女人一处，中间为从战场上生还的大野治长、毛利胜永、速水守久以及其他武士，最里乃是丰臣秀赖和几个侍童。

paragraphs.source_en: The smell of the women's hair oil was bad enough, but the odor of the men was fouler still. Nearly all were wounded and caked in blood and grime; compounded by the rainy season's damp heat, a sharp stench filled the granary. Every face was ashen.

units.source_en: The smell of the women's hair oil was bad enough, but the odor of the men was fouler still.
units.source_zh: 女人发油的味道自不必说，男人身上的气味更是难闻。

units.source_en: Nearly all were wounded and caked in blood and grime; compounded by the rainy season's damp heat, a sharp stench filled the granary.

units.source_en: Every face was ashen.

paragraphs.source_zh: 女人发油的味道自不必说，男人身上的气味更是难闻。他们几乎都受了伤，一身血污，加上梅雨季节的潮湿和闷热，谷仓里充满了一股刺鼻的恶臭。每个人都面如死灰。

paragraphs.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō continually patrolled the granary, occasionally stepping outside for air before going back in.

units.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō continually patrolled the granary, occasionally stepping outside for air before going back in.
units.source_zh: 奥原信十郎不断在谷仓巡视，偶尔走到外边透透气，然后再次回到仓中。

paragraphs.source_en: Only by doing this did Shinjūrō gradually calm himself. Would Princess Sen's plea have any effect at all? If Lord Ieyasu's or Hidetada's men came openly and honorably to receive them, he would entrust mother and son to them. Otherwise, he would never let anyone touch so much as a hair on their heads.

units.source_en: Only by doing this did Shinjūrō gradually calm himself.
units.source_zh: 如此，信十郎的心才慢慢平静下来。

units.source_zh: 若家康公和秀忠属下堂堂正正前来迎接，便将母子二人交与他们。

units.source_en: Otherwise, he would never let anyone touch so much as a hair on their heads.
units.source_zh: 若非如此，他断不会让任何人碰二人一根汗毛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如此，信十郎的心才慢慢平静下来。千姬的乞求到底管不管用？若家康公和秀忠属下堂堂正正前来迎接，便将母子二人交与他们。若非如此，他断不会让任何人碰二人一根汗毛。

paragraphs.source_en: What worried Shinjūrō most was that someone might succumb to the granary's oppressive heat and go mad with despair. It would be one thing if such a person harmed himself; far worse if he turned a weapon upon Lady Yodo and her son. That fear kept him constantly on guard. Yet Lady Yodo's conduct greatly surprised him.

units.source_en: What worried Shinjūrō most was that someone might succumb to the granary's oppressive heat and go mad with despair.

paragraphs.source_en: Shinjūrō had assumed that Lady Yodo was the person most likely to rage and scream. But even after midnight she remained seated with perfect composure, quietly counting her prayer beads and softly invoking the Buddha.

units.source_en: Shinjūrō had assumed that Lady Yodo was the person most likely to rage and scream.

units.source_en: But even after midnight she remained seated with perfect composure, quietly counting her prayer beads and softly invoking the Buddha.
units.source_zh: 可是午夜过后，她仍端然而坐，安静地数着念珠，小声念佛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信十郎原本以为，最有可能咆哮大叫的便是淀夫人。可是午夜过后，她仍端然而坐，安静地数着念珠，小声念佛。

paragraphs.source_en: It was not until after dawn, when Harunaga sent Lady Nii to Ieyasu's headquarters, that Shinjūrō understood Lady Yodo: she too was simply a mother, placing all her hopes in Princess Sen, who had gone to beg for her son's life.

units.source_en: It was not until after dawn, when Harunaga sent Lady Nii to Ieyasu's headquarters, that Shinjūrō understood Lady Yodo: she too was simply a mother, placing all her hopes in Princess Sen, who had gone to beg for her son's life.
units.source_zh: 直到天亮后，治长派出二位局前往家康大营的时候，信十郎才明白了淀夫人：她其实也是一个普通母亲，她把希望完全寄托在了前去为儿子乞命的千姬身上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 直到天亮后，治长派出二位局前往家康大营的时候，信十郎才明白了淀夫人：她其实也是一个普通母亲，她把希望完全寄托在了前去为儿子乞命的千姬身上。

paragraphs.source_en: Lady Nii was sent to Ieyasu's headquarters because Kagatsume Tadazumi and Teshima Gyōbu had entered the castle on Ieyasu's orders and ordered that a register of the survivors be drawn up. The two men had already dimly sensed that people were hiding in the granary. When a retainer learned their purpose, he reported it to Shinjūrō, who met them together with Katsunaga's younger brother, Kageyu.

paragraphs.source_en: Even after surviving the battlefield, Kageyu still longed for another fierce clash with the enemy and naturally would not let the two envoys come within a step of the Ashida compound.
